name: phaser
licenseQuote: The MIT License (MIT) / Copyright (c) 2026 Richard Davey, Phaser Studio Inc.
popularity: unknown (npm and GitHub statistics were not reachable here)
summaryEn: A 2D HTML5 game framework with WebGL and Canvas rendering, scenes, sprites, physics and input.
summaryKo: WebGL과 Canvas로 그리는 2D 웹 게임 프레임워크로, 장면, 스프라이트, 물리, 입력을 한 번에 제공해요.
guideEn: Pick Phaser for a full-featured 2D browser game when you want scenes, an asset loader, physics and input in one framework; use PixiJS instead if you only need a renderer. Start from a Phaser.Game config, Scene classes (preload, create, update), the loader and game objects. Phaser 4 replaced the v3 pipeline system with a node-based WebGL renderer, so v3 custom pipelines and shaders do not carry over; the README points to changelog/v4/4.0/MIGRATION-GUIDE.md and a v3-to-v4 migration skill in skills/v3-to-v4-migration before using old v3 snippets.
guideKo: 씬, 에셋 로더, 물리, 입력이 모두 들어 있는 2D 웹 게임이 필요하면 Phaser를 고르고, 렌더러만 필요하면 PixiJS를 써요. Phaser.Game 설정, Scene 클래스(preload, create, update), 로더와 게임 오브젝트부터 시작해요. Phaser 4는 v3의 파이프라인 시스템을 노드 기반 WebGL 렌더러로 바꿨기 때문에 v3의 커스텀 파이프라인과 셰이더는 그대로 쓸 수 없어요. 예전 v3 예제를 쓰기 전에 README가 안내하는 changelog/v4/4.0/MIGRATION-GUIDE.md와 skills/v3-to-v4-migration을 확인해요.
reason: MIT, active, current major 4.x. Last commit Aug 2026 is within 12 months.
checked: LICENSE.md, README (v4 renderer and migration sections), git log, npm latest 4.2.1 (MIT)

name: pixi.js
licenseQuote: The MIT License / Copyright (c) 2013-2023 Mathew Groves, Chad Engler
popularity: unknown (npm and GitHub statistics were not reachable here)
summaryEn: A fast 2D renderer (WebGL and WebGPU) for sprites, text, graphics and filters.
summaryKo: 스프라이트, 텍스트, 그래픽, 필터를 빠르게 그리는 2D 렌더러(WebGL, WebGPU)예요.
guideEn: Pick PixiJS when you need a fast 2D rendering layer and will bring your own game logic, UI or physics; pick Phaser for a batteries-included game framework. Start from Application, Container, Sprite, Assets.load and the ticker. The README shows the application initialised asynchronously with await app.init({...}) before it is used, so do not pass options to the constructor as in older versions.
guideKo: 게임 로직, UI, 물리를 직접 붙일 빠른 2D 렌더링 층이 필요하면 PixiJS를, 모든 것이 들어 있는 게임 프레임워크가 필요하면 Phaser를 골라요. Application, Container, Sprite, Assets.load, ticker부터 시작해요. README는 쓰기 전에 await app.init({...})로 비동기 초기화를 하는 방식을 보여 주니, 옛 버전처럼 생성자에 옵션을 넘기지 않아요.
concerns: LICENSE copyright line reads 2013-2023 but the repository is actively maintained (commit Nov 2026).
checked: LICENSE, README (await app.init), git log, npm latest 8.23.0 (MIT)

name: three
licenseQuote: The MIT License / Copyright © 2010-2026 three.js authors
popularity: unknown (npm and GitHub statistics were not reachable here)
summaryEn: The standard 3D library for the web: scenes, cameras, meshes, materials, lights, loaders.
summaryKo: 웹 3D의 표준 라이브러리로, 장면, 카메라, 메시, 재질, 조명, 로더를 제공해요.
guideEn: Pick three.js for custom 3D in the browser (visualisations, viewers, games) when you want a lower-level scene graph rather than an engine editor. Start from Scene, PerspectiveCamera, a renderer, Mesh with Geometry and Material, and GLTFLoader. The README says the current builds include WebGL and WebGPU renderers, and it versions by release number (0.x) with a Migration Guide on the wiki, so check that guide for the installed version rather than trusting older snippets.
guideKo: 브라우저에서 직접 만드는 3D(시각화, 뷰어, 게임)가 필요하면 three.js를 고르고, 엔진 에디터보다 낮은 수준의 씬 그래프를 원할 때 맞아요. Scene, PerspectiveCamera, renderer, Geometry와 Material을 가진 Mesh, GLTFLoader부터 시작해요. README에 따르면 현재 빌드는 WebGL과 WebGPU 렌더러를 포함하고, 버전이 0.x 릴리스 번호라서 오래된 예제 대신 위키의 마이그레이션 가이드로 설치한 버전과의 차이를 확인해요.
checked: LICENSE, README (migration link, renderers), git log, npm latest 0.187.0 (MIT)

name: kaplay
licenseQuote: MIT License / Copyright (c) 2025 KAPLAY Team
popularity: unknown (npm and GitHub statistics were not reachable here)
summaryEn: A small, beginner-friendly 2D game library with a component-based API (successor to Kaboom).
summaryKo: 컴포넌트 방식 API를 가진 작고 쉬운 2D 게임 라이브러리로, Kaboom의 후속이에요.
guideEn: Pick KAPLAY for quick 2D prototypes and small games with minimal setup; choose Phaser for larger projects. Start by calling kaplay({...}), then add game objects with components such as sprite, pos, area and body. By default (global option true) kaplay() imports all functions into global scope; pass global: false to get a context handle instead. The "kaplay/global" import only provides global TypeScript types, not the functions themselves.
guideKo: 설정이 거의 없는 빠른 2D 프로토타입과 작은 게임에는 KAPLAY를, 더 큰 프로젝트에는 Phaser를 골라요. kaplay({...})를 호출하고 sprite, pos, area, body 같은 컴포넌트로 오브젝트를 만들어요. 기본값(global 옵션이 true)에서는 kaplay()가 모든 함수를 전역으로 가져오고, global: false를 주면 컨텍스트 핸들을 써요. "kaplay/global"을 가져오는 것은 전역 TypeScript 타입만 불러올 뿐 함수를 만들어 주지는 않아요.
warningsEn: Successor-to-Kaboom statement is not confirmed by the repository README.
warningsKo: Kaboom의 후속이라는 설명은 저장소 README에서 확인하지 못했어요.
concerns: Kaboom succession not confirmed in README text.
problems: Original guide said use "kaplay/global" to put functions in global scope; README says it loads global TypeScript types only (global functions come from kaplay() with global default true). Corrected.

Claim that it continues Kaboom and that the kaboom package should not be installed is not in the README; removed from the guide (the summary keeps 'successor to Kaboom' as the original proposer stated; not verified in the clone).
checked: LICENSE, README (kaplay global types section), src/types.ts global option default true, package.json exports, npm latest 3001.0.19 (MIT)

name: @dimforge/rapier2d-compat
licenseQuote: Apache License Version 2.0, January 2004 (root LICENSE and bindings/typescript/LICENSE); Cargo.toml: license = "Apache-2.0"
popularity: unknown (npm and GitHub statistics were not reachable here)
summaryEn: A fast Rust physics engine (2D and 3D) compiled to WebAssembly for JavaScript.
summaryKo: 러스트로 만든 빠른 물리 엔진(2D, 3D)을 WebAssembly로 컴파일해 자바스크립트에서 쓰게 해요.
guideEn: Pick Rapier for rigid-body physics in a browser or Node game; matter.js is a pure-JS alternative for 2D only. Create a World, add RigidBody and Collider descriptions, then call world.step() each frame and read the positions back. The bindings README lists several npm flavours: rapier2d and rapier3d (wasm file separate), -simd (needs simd128 browser support), -deterministic (guaranteed cross-platform determinism; the plain build is only deterministic on the same machine), and -compat versions that embed the wasm as base64 for bundler support. The init source says init() must be called and awaited before any library method. The 0.21.0 changelog lists breaking changes: World, PhysicsPipeline.step and the set removal methods now take a SoftBodySet argument.
guideKo: 브라우저나 Node 게임에서 강체 물리가 필요하면 Rapier를 고르고, 2D만 필요한 순수 JS 대안은 matter.js예요. World를 만들고 RigidBody와 Collider를 추가한 뒤 프레임마다 world.step()을 호출해 위치를 읽어요. 바인딩 README에 따르면 npm 패키지는 여러 종류예요. rapier2d와 rapier3d(wasm 파일 별도), simd128 지원이 필요한 -simd, 플랫폼 간 결정성을 보장하는 -deterministic(기본 빌드는 같은 기기에서만 결정적), 번들러 호환을 위해 wasm을 base64로 내장한 -compat이 있어요. 소스의 init 주석은 라이브러리 메서드를 쓰기 전에 init()을 호출하고 기다려야 한다고 해요. 0.21.0 변경 기록에는 World, PhysicsPipeline.step, 제거 메서드가 SoftBodySet 인자를 받는 호환 깨짐 변경이 있어요.
warningsEn: The repository dimforge/rapier.js is merged into dimforge/rapier (bindings/typescript); the catalog points to the new repository.
warningsKo: dimforge/rapier.js는 dimforge/rapier(bindings/typescript)로 합쳐졌어요. 카탈로그는 새 저장소를 가리켜요.
concerns: Package choice (2d/3d, compat/simd/deterministic) depends on the project; the 3D package is @dimforge/rapier3d-compat.
problems: Repository was wrong: dimforge/rapier.js README says it was merged into dimforge/rapier (typescript directory); npm repository field is dimforge/rapier. Repo, commit, cloneDir, lastCommit and license source replaced.
Original guide claimed 'deterministic stepping' for the plain package; README says only the -deterministic build guarantees cross-platform determinism. Corrected.
init requirement confirmed in rapier-compat/src2d/init.ts.
checked: dimforge/rapier.js README (merged notice), clone of dimforge/rapier: root LICENSE, bindings/typescript README and CHANGELOG 0.21.0, rapier-compat init.ts, npm registry (latest 0.21.0, repository dimforge/rapier)

name: konva
licenseQuote: MIT License / Original work Copyright (C) 2011 - 2013 by Eric Rowell (KineticJS)
popularity: unknown (npm and GitHub statistics were not reachable here)
summaryEn: A 2D canvas library with a scene graph for interactive shapes, drag and drop, transforms and events.
summaryKo: 도형, 드래그 앤 드롭, 변형, 이벤트를 다루는 씬 그래프 기반 2D 캔버스 라이브러리예요.
guideEn: Pick Konva for interactive 2D canvas editors with draggable shapes; use Fabric.js if you want an object model with SVG and JSON serialisation, or PixiJS for game-style rendering. The README builds a Stage, adds a Layer to it, then adds shapes to the layer, and mentions Stage, Layer, FastLayer, Group and Shape. Check the docs at konvajs.org for events, transforms and export before copying older KineticJS-era snippets.
guideKo: 드래그할 수 있는 도형이 있는 인터랙티브 2D 캔버스 에디터에는 Konva를 고르고, SVG와 JSON 직렬화가 있는 객체 모델이 필요하면 Fabric.js, 게임식 렌더링은 PixiJS를 써요. README는 Stage를 만들고 Layer를 붙인 뒤 레이어에 도형을 추가하며, Stage, Layer, FastLayer, Group, Shape를 언급해요. 이벤트, 변형, 내보내기는 konvajs.org 문서를 확인하고 KineticJS 시절 예제는 그대로 쓰지 않아요.
concerns: Capabilities such as export and hit detection come from the project description, not read in detail.
problems: Removed the 'keep the number of Layers small' pitfall and the Transformer claim: not found in the README.
checked: LICENSE, README (Stage/Layer example, FastLayer), git log, npm latest 10.9.1 (MIT)

name: fabric
licenseQuote: MIT License / Copyright (c) 2008-2015 Printio (Juriy Zaytsev, Maxim Chernyak)
popularity: unknown (npm and GitHub statistics were not reachable here)
summaryEn: A canvas library with an object model, SVG import and export, and JSON serialisation.
summaryKo: 객체 모델, SVG 가져오기와 내보내기, JSON 직렬화를 갖춘 캔버스 라이브러리예요.
guideEn: Pick Fabric.js for image or design editors that need selectable objects, SVG and JSON. The README says the fabric package is now a legacy compatibility facade that stays supported and re-exports @fabricjs/browser; new browser apps should prefer @fabricjs/browser and Node apps @fabricjs/node, and fabric and every @fabricjs/* package must be kept on matching versions. Existing imports like import { Canvas } from 'fabric' keep working. The CHANGELOG records a breaking change to the static fromURL method of the image class, so callback-style snippets from old tutorials do not apply.
guideKo: 선택 가능한 객체, SVG, JSON이 필요한 이미지나 디자인 에디터에는 Fabric.js를 골라요. README에 따르면 fabric 패키지는 이제 호환용 레거시 파사드로 계속 지원되고 @fabricjs/browser를 다시 내보내요. 새 브라우저 앱은 @fabricjs/browser, Node 앱은 @fabricjs/node를 권하고, fabric과 모든 @fabricjs/* 패키지는 같은 버전으로 맞춰야 해요. import { Canvas } from 'fabric' 같은 기존 import는 계속 동작해요. CHANGELOG에는 이미지 클래스의 정적 fromURL 메서드가 호환이 깨지게 바뀐 기록이 있어서 옛 튜토리얼의 콜백 방식 예제는 맞지 않아요.
warningsEn: README prefers @fabricjs/browser (npm 7.5.0-beta.1 exists) for new apps; fabric stays supported.
warningsKo: README는 새 앱에 @fabricjs/browser를 권해요(npm에 7.5.0-beta.1이 있어요). fabric도 계속 지원돼요.
problems: Original guide treated 'fabric' as the modern package and said v5-or-earlier global namespace was out of date; README now describes fabric as a legacy facade and prefers @fabricjs/browser. Guide rewritten. Install command left as npm install fabric (latest 7.4.0, MIT) since README still documents it; @fabricjs/browser latest on npm is a beta (7.5.0-beta.1).
checked: LICENSE, README installation and packages sections, CHANGELOG (fromURL breaking change, 7.4.0), npm latest fabric 7.4.0 and @fabricjs/browser 7.5.0-beta.1 (MIT)

name: motion
licenseQuote: The MIT License (MIT) / Copyright (c) 2024 [Motion](https://motion.dev) B.V.
popularity: unknown (npm and GitHub statistics were not reachable here)
summaryEn: An open source animation library for JavaScript, React and Vue (formerly Framer Motion).
summaryKo: 자바스크립트, React, Vue용 오픈소스 애니메이션 라이브러리로, 예전 이름은 Framer Motion이에요.

The README says Framer Motion is now Motion: install motion and import from "motion/react" instead of framer-motion; JavaScript uses import { animate } from "motion", and Vue has its own package motion-v. guideKo: React의 UI 애니메이션(motion 컴포넌트)이나 순수 JS의 animate()에는 Motion을 골라요. README에 따르면 Framer Motion은 이제 Motion이라서 motion을 설치하고 framer-motion이 아니라 "motion/react"에서 가져와요. 자바스크립트는 import { animate } from "motion"을 쓰고 Vue는 별도 패키지 motion-v예요. README는 Motion이 MIT라고 밝히고, Motion+는 별도 유료 상품이며 라이브러리에는 필요하지 않아요.
warningsEn: Motion+ is a separate paid product; only the MIT library is recommended.
warningsKo: Motion+는 별도 유료 상품이에요. 추천 대상은 MIT 라이브러리뿐이에요.

name: d3
licenseQuote: Copyright 2010-2026 Mike Bostock / Permission to use, copy, modify, and/or distribute this software for any purpose with or without fee is hereby granted
popularity: unknown (npm and GitHub statistics were not reachable here)
summaryEn: Low-level building blocks for custom data visualisation: scales, shapes, axes, layouts, geo, force.
summaryKo: 스케일, 도형, 축, 레이아웃, 지도, 힘 그래프 같은 맞춤 데이터 시각화용 저수준 구성 요소예요.
capabilities: custom charts in SVG or canvas
guideEn: Pick D3 when you need a bespoke visualisation; for standard charts use Recharts, Chart.js or ECharts instead. The README describes it as a low-level approach built on web standards, and package.json sets type module (ESM). Use its pieces (scales, shapes, axes) to compute geometry and let your framework render the DOM if you prefer. Since D3 4.0 the API is a flat namespace per the 4.0 notes in CHANGES.md: d3.scale.linear became d3.scaleLinear and d3.svg.axis became d3.axisTop/Right/Bottom/Left, so v3-era snippets fail.
guideKo: 맞춤형 시각화에는 D3를, 일반적인 차트에는 Recharts, Chart.js, ECharts를 골라요. README는 웹 표준 위의 저수준 접근이라고 소개하고, package.json은 type이 module(ESM)이에요. 스케일, 도형, 축 같은 조각으로 기하를 계산하고 DOM은 프레임워크가 그리게 해도 돼요. CHANGES.md의 4.0 항목에 따르면 D3 4.0부터 평평한 네임스페이스가 되어 d3.scale.linear는 d3.scaleLinear로, d3.svg.axis는 d3.axisTop, Right, Bottom, Left로 바뀌었으니 v3 시절 코드는 동작하지 않아요.
concerns: Recharts, Chart.js alternatives are not in the clone; they are named only as options.
problems: The d3.scale.linear and d3.svg.axis removal happened in 4.0, not 7; guide corrected to cite CHANGES.md.
checked: LICENSE (ISC text), README, package.json type module, CHANGES.md 4.0 section, npm latest 7.9.2 (ISC)

name: echarts
licenseQuote: Apache License Version 2.0, January 2004
popularity: unknown (npm and GitHub statistics were not reachable here)
summaryEn: A declarative charting library with many chart types, large-data support and a rich option object.
summaryKo: 선언형 옵션으로 많은 종류의 차트와 대용량 데이터를 그리는 차트 라이브러리예요.
capabilities: line, bar, pie, scatter, heatmap, map charts
guideEn: Pick ECharts for rich dashboards and big datasets where one option object describes the chart; use D3 for fully custom graphics. Start with echarts.init(dom) and myChart.setOption(option), as shown in the package README. For smaller bundles import from echarts/core and register only the charts (echarts/charts), components (echarts/components) and renderers (echarts/renderers) you use, as the package README describes.
guideKo: 옵션 객체 하나로 차트를 정의하는 풍부한 대시보드와 큰 데이터에는 ECharts를, 완전히 맞춤인 그래픽에는 D3를 골라요. package README처럼 echarts.init(dom)과 myChart.setOption(option)으로 시작해요. 번들을 줄이려면 echarts/core에서 가져오고 쓰는 차트(echarts/charts), 컴포넌트(echarts/components), 렌더러(echarts/renderers)만 등록해요.
concerns: licenses/LICENSE-d3 holds the bundled d3 license (ISC-style). NOTICE file is the Apache one.
reason: Apache-2.0, Apache top-level project, last commit Oct 2026.
checked: LICENSE (Apache-2.0), NOTICE and licenses dir listing, package.README.md (core import, init, setOption), npm latest 6.1.0 (Apache-2.0)

name: hono
licenseQuote: MIT License / Copyright (c) 2021 - present, Yusuke Wada and Hono contributors
popularity: unknown (npm and GitHub statistics were not reachable here)
summaryEn: A small, fast web framework on Web Standards that runs on Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Bun, Node and more.
summaryKo: Web 표준 기반의 작고 빠른 웹 프레임워크로 Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Bun, Node 등에서 돌아가요.
guideEn: Pick Hono for lightweight TypeScript APIs that must run on edge runtimes or several JS runtimes; Fastify or Express suit Node-only services. The README example is new Hono(), app.get('/', (c) => c.text('Hono!')) and export default app, and it lists built-in and third-party middleware and a hono/tiny preset. The Node tests in the repository use the separate @hono/node-server package to serve the app, so on Node add that adapter. The README links docs/MIGRATION.md for breaking changes between versions.
guideKo: 엣지나 여러 JS 런타임에서 돌아야 하는 가벼운 TypeScript API에는 Hono를, Node 전용 서비스에는 Fastify나 Express를 골라요. README 예제는 new Hono(), app.get('/', (c) => c.text('Hono!')), export default app이고, 내장과 서드파티 미들웨어와 hono/tiny 프리셋을 소개해요. 저장소의 Node 테스트는 별도 패키지 @hono/node-server로 앱을 띄우니 Node에서는 그 어댑터를 추가해요. 버전 간 호환 변경은 README가 안내하는 docs/MIGRATION.md에 있어요.
problems: Original claim that Hono 'only exports a fetch handler' was not in the README; rewritten from what runtime-tests and package.json show (@hono/node-server).
checked: LICENSE, README (example, features), package.json (@hono/node-server devDependency), runtime-tests/node, docs/MIGRATION.md exists, npm latest 4.13.18 (MIT)

name: drizzle-orm
licenseQuote: Apache License Version 2.0, January 2004
popularity: unknown (npm and GitHub statistics were not reachable here)
summaryEn: A TypeScript ORM and SQL query builder with schema-as-code and migrations through drizzle-kit.
summaryKo: 스키마를 코드로 쓰는 TypeScript ORM이자 SQL 쿼리 빌더로, 마이그레이션은 drizzle-kit이 맡아요.
guideEn: Pick Drizzle for a thin, SQL-close, type-safe ORM in TypeScript with zero runtime dependencies; Prisma is the heavier alternative with its own schema language. The README says it supports PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite (including serverless drivers) and that Drizzle Kit generates SQL migration files. The source has per-dialect modules (drizzle-orm/pg-core, mysql-core, sqlite-core) and per-driver modules, so copy imports from the docs for your dialect and driver. npm latest is 0.45.4 while 1.0.0-rc and beta releases exist under other dist-tags, so snippets for 1.0 may differ from what npm install gives you.
guideKo: SQL에 가깝고 런타임 의존성이 없는 얇은 타입 안전 TypeScript ORM에는 Drizzle을, 자체 스키마 언어를 쓰는 더 무거운 대안은 Prisma예요. README에 따르면 PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite(서버리스 드라이버 포함)를 지원하고 Drizzle Kit이 SQL 마이그레이션 파일을 만들어요. 소스에는 방언별 모듈(drizzle-orm/pg-core, mysql-core, sqlite-core)과 드라이버별 모듈이 있으니 쓰는 방언과 드라이버에 맞는 import를 문서에서 가져와요. npm latest는 0.45.4이고 1.0 rc와 beta는 다른 dist-tag에 있어서 1.0 예제는 npm install로 받은 버전과 다를 수 있어요.
warningsEn: npm latest is 0.x; a 1.0 release candidate exists under the rc dist-tag.
warningsKo: npm latest는 0.x이고 1.0 릴리스 후보는 rc dist-tag에 있어요.
problems: Original guide said 'a different package per dialect import path', which is wrong (one package with dialect subpaths); rewritten. Added the dist-tag fact from the npm registry. drizzle-kit latest 0.31.11 (MIT) confirmed for the second install command.
checked: LICENSE, README, drizzle-orm/src listing, drizzle-kit README, npm dist-tags (latest 0.45.4; rc 1.0.0-rc.5), drizzle-kit latest 0.31.11 MIT

name: @modelcontextprotocol/server
licenseQuote: The MCP project is undergoing a licensing transition from the MIT License to the Apache License, Version 2.0 ("Apache-2.0"). / Apache License Version 2.0, January 2004

summaryEn: The official TypeScript SDK (v2) for building MCP servers; a separate client package exists.
summaryKo: MCP 서버를 만드는 공식 TypeScript SDK(v2)이고, 클라이언트는 별도 패키지로 나뉘어 있어요.
capabilities: MCP servers with tools, resources, prompts
guideEn: Pick this to build an MCP server in TypeScript. The README says main is v2, the stable line implementing the 2026-07-28 MCP spec: install @modelcontextprotocol/server (and @modelcontextprotocol/client for clients). The README example creates new McpServer({ name, version }), registers a tool with server.registerTool and a zod inputSchema (imported from zod/v4), and connects a StdioServerTransport imported from @modelcontextprotocol/server/stdio. The older single package @modelcontextprotocol/sdk is v1.x, kept on the v1.x branch with bug and security fixes for at least six months after the v2 release; code importing it is v1, and the migration guide covers upgrading. Optional middleware packages exist for Node, Express, Fastify and Hono.
guideKo: TypeScript로 MCP 서버를 만들 때 골라요. README에 따르면 main은 v2로 2026-07-28 MCP 사양을 구현하는 안정 버전이에요. @modelcontextprotocol/server(클라이언트는 @modelcontextprotocol/client)를 설치해요. README 예제는 new McpServer({ name, version })을 만들고 server.registerTool과 zod/v4의 inputSchema로 도구를 등록한 뒤 @modelcontextprotocol/server/stdio의 StdioServerTransport로 연결해요. 예전 단일 패키지 @modelcontextprotocol/sdk는 v1.x로 v1.x 브랜치에서 v2 출시 후 최소 6개월간 버그와 보안 수정을 받고, 그 패키지를 가져오는 코드는 v1이며 업그레이드는 마이그레이션 가이드에 있어요. Node, Express, Fastify, Hono용 선택 미들웨어 패키지도 있어요.
warningsEn: Many tutorials still use the v1 package @modelcontextprotocol/sdk.
warningsKo: 많은 튜토리얼이 아직 v1 패키지 @modelcontextprotocol/sdk를 써요.
concerns: LICENSE mixes MIT (contributions not yet relicensed) and Apache-2.0; both are on the allowed list. Root package.json version differs from published 2.4.0 (server package.json says 2.4.0).
reason: Official SDK, permissive, active, v2 is the current line.
problems: Dropped the 'TypeScript 6 needs types: [node]' claim (not found in README or get-started docs). Corrected 'bug fixes only' to bug and security fixes for at least six months. Removed OAuth capability (not read).

README는 표현식으로 쿼리를 만들어요. pl.scan_parquet(...)가 최적화되는 LazyFrame을 만들고, pl.col(...) 표현식으로 filter, group_by, agg를 쓰고, .collect()로 실행해요. 범위 안의 DataFrame과 LazyFrame에 pl.sql(...)도 쓸 수 있어요. PyPI 패키지는 2.1.0이니 옛 예제 대신 설치한 버전의 docs.pola.rs를 확인해요.

guideEn: Pick pefile for static inspection of Windows executables in Python (headers, sections, imports, exports, resources); use LIEF when you also need to modify or build binaries. Open a file with pefile.PE(path) and walk pe.sections and the import directory. The README warns that the repository holds a large compressed test corpus whose history makes a full clone much larger than the library, so install with pip instead of cloning. Latest release 2024.8.26 is over a year old, though commits continue.

name: capstone
licenseQuote: This is the software license for Capstone disassembly framework. / Copyright (c) 2013, COSEINC. All rights reserved. Redistribution and use in source and binary forms
popularity: unknown (npm and GitHub statistics were not reachable here)
summaryEn: A multi-architecture disassembly framework with Python and other bindings.
summaryKo: 여러 아키텍처를 지원하는 디스어셈블리 프레임워크로, 파이썬 등의 바인딩을 제공해요.
capabilities: disassemble x86, ARM, MIPS and more
guideEn: Pick Capstone to turn raw machine-code bytes into instructions in scripts and analysis tools. The README lists many architectures (ARM, AArch64, Mips, PPC, RISC-V, x86 and more), details and semantics (implicit registers read and written) for each decoded instruction, and a pure-C core with Python and other bindings; pip install capstone installs the Python binding. In Python the repository tests create md = Cs(arch, mode) and iterate md.disasm(code, address). Use another tool to locate the code bytes in a binary first.
guideKo: 스크립트와 분석 도구에서 원시 기계어 바이트를 명령어로 바꿀 때 Capstone을 골라요. README는 ARM, AArch64, Mips, PPC, RISC-V, x86 등 많은 아키텍처, 디코딩한 명령어마다의 상세 정보와 의미(읽고 쓰는 암묵적 레지스터), 순수 C 코어와 파이썬 등의 바인딩을 소개하고, pip install capstone으로 파이썬 바인딩을 설치해요. 저장소의 파이썬 테스트는 md = Cs(arch, mode)를 만들고 md.disasm(code, address)를 순회해요. 바이너리 안의 코드 바이트는 먼저 다른 도구로 찾아요.
warningsEn: Parts derived from LLVM carry a separate license (LICENSE_LLVM.TXT) that was not reviewed in full.
warningsKo: LLVM에서 온 부분은 별도 라이선스(LICENSE_LLVM.TXT)가 있고 끝까지 검토하지 못했어요.

problems: Removed the Unicorn and Keystone remark and the pefile/LIEF pairing (not in README).
checked: LICENSES/LICENSE.TXT and LICENSE_BSD_3_CLAUSE.txt heads, README, bindings/python README and tests, PyPI json (5.0.9, BSD classifier)

summaryEn: A binary analysis platform with symbolic execution, CFG recovery and decompilation for many architectures.
summaryKo: 여러 아키텍처에서 심볼릭 실행, CFG 복원, 디컴파일을 제공하는 바이너리 분석 플랫폼이에요.
guideEn: Pick angr for automated binary analysis such as symbolic execution and control-flow recovery; use Capstone for plain disassembly. The README says the most common operation is loading a binary with angr.Project(path) and its example passes auto_load_libs=False. It recommends installing in a virtualenv (mkvirtualenv angr, then python -m pip install angr). Symbolic execution can be slow on large programs, so check docs.angr.io for exploration strategies.
guideKo: 심볼릭 실행이나 제어 흐름 복원 같은 자동 바이너리 분석에는 angr를, 단순 디스어셈블에는 Capstone을 골라요. README에 따르면 가장 흔한 작업은 angr.Project(path)로 바이너리를 불러오는 것이고, 예제는 auto_load_libs=False를 넘겨요. 가상환경을 만들어 python -m pip install angr로 설치하길 권해요. 큰 프로그램에서는 심볼릭 실행이 느릴 수 있으니 탐색 전략은 docs.angr.io를 확인해요.
